title: Curfew
text:
DIRECTED BY JULIAN MEANS
CURFEW
IS THIS CREATURE REAL?
CREATURE SIGHTINGS IN COLDBROOK!
Town folks have been raving about this "creature" that is sneaking around Coldbrooks surrounding forest area. Multiple people say they have seen it running as fast as a leopard and tall as a basketball hoop and louder than a school bell ringing. The noises that it makes during the night echo throughout the town.
A Coldbrook citizen said, "I can't sleep at night, the only thing I can think about is where that creature is, and if it's going to attack me." No sightings have actually been proven true at this time, but be aware if these rumors are true who knows what's out there?
ATTENTION
PLEASE STAY OUT OF THE WOODS
TOWN CURFEW AT 9:00PM
until further notice
STARRING
ALEXIS VANLEUVEN
SYDNEY LOVERING
CHUCK GRIFFITH
KATIE GRIFFITH
Do NOT engage with this creature if you see it. Immediately go back into your houses and stay inside.
BOOK AN AD!
The creature hasn't been seen since yesterday 11th, at 10:45 AM.
